purpose: Research alongside pending Gate 1; no model evaluation.

homometry.coded_mask: 0.6 + 0.4*x/96 at fixed laboratory coordinates; breaks this example only, not a universal guarantee.

babinet.normalization: Both differences use the same ORIGINAL physical peak; no separate normalization.

registered_reference_nearest_option.limitation: Panel boundaries and registration are supplied; this is NOT a blind screenshot or VLM baseline.

item_diagnostics.margin_caveat: 0.02 is descriptive, not a human or model perception threshold. 240px reproduces option quantization and nearest resize; smaller sizes use area averaging followed by 8-bit requantization.

scalars.note: Thresholds are the transition from code 0 to 1 under nearest rounding, before any resize. Wilson widths are descriptive, not a power analysis.

central_curvature.aperture: 16 by 72 slit rotated 25 degrees; same cell averaged raster as simulator
central_curvature.scope: Identity for the discrete raster measure. This checks an independent direct sum, not another FFT.
